title: 23 进可攻退可守24 招揽
content_zh:
金雁功主要锻炼腿部肌肉筋骨。
此功法难度极大，对资质、悟性要求很高。
林哲羽有了蛮牛拳打下的基础，浑身筋肉皮膜饱满，已经达到了锻骨境，上起手来，还算轻松。
金雁功一共八层，修炼到第三层圆满，一身实力就能够达到炼脏巅峰。
修炼到第四层，实力便达到了气血境。
之后，每一提升一个层次，浑身气血都会发生一次气血质变。
如果能够将金雁功修炼到第八层圆满，在气血境一道，可以达到气血四变的程度。
腿功一道，精通的武者极为稀少。
特别是能够修炼到气血四变程度的腿功，那更是珍贵无比。
虽然仅仅只是二流中游层次的武功，但珍贵程度上，已经能够媲美二流顶尖的武学了。
腿功修炼到精深之处，进可攻，退可守，来去如风，天然立于不败之地。
院子里。
梁松在地上画了大大小小数十个圆圈。
地面上，摆放了十几根直径二十厘米左右的木桩，林哲羽站在木桩上，快速地移动着。
时不时从木桩上跃下，以奇异地步法在圆圈中来回腾挪。
这是金雁功特有的步法。
要想练好金雁功，就必须先学会金雁功的独特步伐。
在梁松的教导下，林哲羽足足花费了三个多小时，才将所有步法牢牢记住。
但运用起来还是有些生涩，需要花费大量的时间苦练才行。
“休息一下吧，欲速则不达。”

“练武是急不来的，讲究张弛有度。”
“你休息下，回去准备准备说书事宜，晚上再过来，继续实战对练。”梁松叫停了林哲羽。
林哲羽喘着气停了下来。
他看向意识中的数据，金雁功的进度不错。
【天道酬勤】
姓名：林哲羽
源力：6
技能：
蛮牛拳（精通3%）
金雁功（未入门68%）
一個早上的修炼，还差三十二进度金雁功就入门了。
晚上再花些功夫，就能够入门了。
有了蛮牛拳的修炼经验，林哲羽已经算不得武道小白，修炼起金雁功来上手极快。
不过这只是开始。
content_en:
Jin Yan Gong mainly exercises the muscles and bones of the legs.
This technique is extremely difficult and requires high qualifications and understanding.
Lin Zheyu had the foundation of Manniu Boxing, and his body was full of muscles and skin. He had already reached the bone forging stage, so it was quite easy to get started.
There are eight levels of Jin Yan Gong. If you practice to the third level, you will be able to reach the peak of internal organs refining.
After cultivating to the fourth level, one's strength has reached the Qi and Blood realm.
After that, every time you advance to a level, your whole body's Qi and blood will undergo a qualitative change.
If you can practice Jin Yan Gong to the eighth level, you can achieve the four changes of qi and blood in the qi and blood realm.
There are very few martial artists who are proficient in leg skills.
Especially the leg skills that can be practiced to the level of four changes of qi and blood are extremely precious.
Although it is only a second-rate middle-level martial arts, its preciousness is comparable to that of the top second-rate martial arts.
Once you practice leg skills to a profound level, you can advance to attack, retreat to defend, come and go like the wind, and you will naturally be invincible.
yard.
Liang Song drew dozens of circles, large and small, on the ground.
On the ground, there were more than a dozen wooden stakes with a diameter of about 20 centimeters. Lin Zheyu stood on the wooden stakes and moved quickly.
From time to time he would jump down from the wooden pile and move back and forth in the circle with strange steps.
This is the unique footwork of Jin Yan Gong.
If you want to practice Jin Yan Gong well, you must first learn the unique steps of Jin Yan Gong.
Under Liang Song's guidance, it took Lin Zheyu more than three hours to memorize all the footwork.
However, it is still a bit awkward to use and requires a lot of time and hard practice.
"Get some rest, haste makes waste."
"You can't rush into martial arts, it's about relaxation and relaxation."
"You take a rest and go back to prepare for the storytelling. Come back in the evening and continue the actual sparring." Liang Song stopped Lin Zheyu.
Lin Zheyu gasped and stopped.
He looked at the data in his mind and saw that Jin Yan Gong was making good progress.
【God rewards those who work hard】
Name: Lin Zheyu
Source Power: 6
Skills:
Barbarian Bull Fist (Proficient 3%)
Jin Yan Gong (68% not yet started)
After one morning of practice, I was still thirty-two steps away from getting started with Jin Yan Gong.
After spending some time at night, you can get started.
With the training experience of Manniu Boxing, Lin Zheyu is no longer a novice in martial arts, and he can master Jinyan Kung very quickly.
But this is just the beginning.
